newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand for most varieties at Calcutta auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand for most varieties at Calcutta auction.

text.p: There was good demand for most categories at this week's Calcutta tea auction, traders said.
But there was no sale in the dust category.
In all 97,584 packages, including 9,941 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.
In the CTC variety, clean well-made Dooars and better liquoring Assams were firm. Major blenders were active, traders said.
In the Orthodox category, clean whole leaf and larger brokens were firm.
